title: Find the driver who scored the most total points in the Monaco Grand Prix b
question: Find the driver who scored the most total points in the Monaco Grand Prix between 2005 and 2015. Calculate the percentage of all their career races where they did not finish in first position.

prediction.sql:
WITH monaco_top AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id, SUM(r.XCL_082) AS total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
      AND ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.XCL_079 <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM results r
WHERE r.XCL_075 = (SELECT driver_id FROM monaco_top)

    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id, SUM(r.XCL_082) AS total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
      AND ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.XCL_079 <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM results r
WHERE r.XCL_075 = (SELECT driver_id FROM monaco_top)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH monaco_top AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id, SUM(r.XCL_079) AS pts
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
      AND ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
    ORDER BY pts DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.XCL_078 <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM results r
WHERE r.XCL_075 = (SELECT driver_id FROM monaco_top)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH monaco_top_driver AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        SUM(r.XCL_083) AS total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races race ON r.XCL_074 = race.XCL_065
    JOIN circuits c ON race.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'Monaco'
      AND race.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
driver_career_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_races,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.XCL_078 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_place_finishes
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.XCL_075 = (SELECT driver_id FROM monaco_top_driver)
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
)
SELECT 
    (dcs.total_races - dcs.first_place_finishes) * 100.0 / dcs.total_races AS percentage_not_first
FROM driver_career_stats dcs
